title: server.cs2_update_required (server → platform, reliable)
description: Steam says this CS2 build is behind (ISteamApps/UpToDateCheck, appid 730); `required_build` is its required_version (the PatchVersion without dots, e.g. 14035). Sent once per required version. Proposed here, FLEET.md §8.1, §14.3.
